title: Why rock artists come to New Orleans
summary: He credits New Orleans itself and the city's giants, and mentions Bonnie Raitt and the Mighty Diamonds.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: But some of the rock people have come in, what do you think has drawn them to New Orleans? Trying to get a New Orleans sound, just the city? Well, you have to be more specific about the particular person. Okay. There's somebody like Bonnie Raitt and Robert Palmer and the Mighty Diamonds. Three unique cases.
